ctx.x: With that band? With Vernon Biddle and the Heath Brothers.

Yeah. Well, they were working with me steady, you know. We came here and played up in Utica, and around New York and Philadelphia, and even went down to Baltimore, Washington... Then we played this (?) in Baltimore... Anyway, we did a lot of dates around... I went into the Three Deuces here with that band, with Little Jimmy Heath and Milt...
I think I was in the Midwest at the time. I was going to school, so I didn't hear that band.
